summary: Mr. Harari discusses the customs for the seventh day of Pesah, focusing on the practice of reading from the book Keri Mo'ed. He details the traditions of early morning pre-dawn readings, including the recitation of the Shirot and Parashat Beshalah as practiced in Middle Eastern communities and in Brooklyn synagogues.
questions: What is the custom for the seventh day of Pesah regarding the book Keri Mo'ed?
Which rabbi wrote Bet HaBehira and what did he say about the seventh day of Pesah?
What did Rabbi Hayyim Palaji write in Mo'ed Kol Hai about waking up early on the seventh day of Pesah?
How is the custom of reading on the seventh day of Pesah practiced in Brooklyn synagogues?
